# TRMT 0.6 — Changelog

## New Features
- **Snow erosion.** Walking through snow wears it down and leaves trails.
- **Speed buff on eroded paths.** Paths at least 2 blocks wide give a small speed bonus (+8 / 16 / 25 %), also on horseback.
- **Permanent erosion stages toggle.** Prevent specific stages from eroding or de-eroding naturally.
- **Whitelist mobs can erode.** Mobs you list in `erosionMobWhitelist` will cause erosion. Use with care: it creates a lot of erosion data.
- **17 new languages** and better translations, thanks to @megatocha.

# New Version Support
- **Minecraft 26.3 support** (Fabric and NeoForge). Thanks to @kaiguy71 for the 26.3 hints.

## Mod Compat
- **Via Romana support:** worn paths count as roads for charting and fast travel (1.20.1 and 1.21.1).

## Fixes
- Joining big servers no longer times out (#63). Forge fix by @kaiserproger.
- No more autosave freezes on servers with many paths (#68).
- Players without TRMT are no longer kicked with an error on NeoForge servers.
- NeoForge 26.1.2 no longer crashes on startup. Fix by @EldritchMoon.
- A partly edited `trmt.json` no longer breaks erosion or crashes the game.
- Erosion is now separate per dimension (#69).
- `/trmt convert-to-vanilla` converts the whole world, with a preview, progress and cancel (#43).
- Standing still no longer wears the block you stand on.
- Slabs, carpets, glass, snow and other see-through blocks no longer reset paths.
- Coarse and fresh dirt stages keep their timers (#60).
- Dirt paths recover to dirt, not grass (#16).
- Sheep graze worn grass (#40).
- Hoes and shovels work on worn blocks only with air above, like vanilla.
- You can build and plant on eroded sand (#45).
- Floating eroded sand falls.
- Worn blocks no longer look brighter than their surroundings (#57).
- Optional fix for shimmering distant paths. `mipmapFix` in `trmt-client.json`.
- Warning in chat when Sodium is installed without Indium (Fabric 1.20.1 and 1.21.1).
- Bonemeal recovery shows its particles again on 1.21 and newer.

## Changed
- Bonemeal and brushes now recover a 3x3 area.
- `/trmt reloadconfig` is now `/trmt reload-config`.

v0.5.1

## New Features

- Grass growth on de-erosion. Eroded grass blocks have a 5% chance to sprout short grass on the block above with each de-erosion step.
- Sneaking suppresses erosion. When sneaking erosion is not triggered.

## Bug Fixes

- De-erosion carry-over. De-erosion cooldowns now carry forward any overshoot from the previous step preventing unloaded chunks cut-out.
- Eroded grass loot table. Eroded grass blocks now correctly drop a grass block with Silk Touch and dirt otherwise.
- Auto-revert under opaque blocks. Eroded blocks under opaque blocks now automatically revert to their vanilla counterpart
- Sugar cane on eroded surfaces. Sugar cane can now be placed on eroded grass, dirt, and coarse dirt when horizontally adjacent to water.
- Waterlogged eroded sand. Sunken eroded sand stages (1–4) now implement Waterloggable and auto-fill with water when adjacent to a water source.
- Vanilal grass spread. Removed bogus mixin that suppressed vanilla grass spreading for any grass block with an erosion entry.
- No erosion when submerged. Grass and dirt blocks don't get eroded when player walks on them while submerged underwater.

# Changelog

## v0.5

### Added Features

- **Leashed mob erosion** — mobs on a leash now cause erosion too, the strength of which can be tweaked via the config file
- **Brush recovery for eroded sand** — eroded sand blocks can be reverted to previous erosion stages using the brush (similar to bonemeal recovery)
- **Tall grass → short grass erosion** — tall grass turns into short grass when trampling before getting destroyed.
- **Per-block de-erosion toggle** — de-erosion can be toggled for each block type via config.
- **Vegetation whitelist in config** — vegetation erosion can be fine tuned via whitelist in config.
- **Migration system on uninstall** — added new command (/trmt convert-to-vanilla) to ease world migration in case mod is uninstalled.
- **Translation support** — all mod strings are now fully localizable via lang files.

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed shovel mining speed on eroded blocks.
- Fixed block drops not working correctly for eroded blocks.
- Fixed saplings not being placeable on eroded grass and dirt.
- Fixed sugarcane being unable to grow/place on stage-0 eroded sand.
- Fixed a visual glitch on eroded sand when a block was placed directly on top. Now no blocks can be placed on top of eroded sand stages 1-4
- Fixed More Culling compat, no more transparency of eroded sand sides.
- Fixed eroded sand stages 1–4 selection outline not matching visual geometry.
- Fixed erosion toggle settings in the config reverting to vanilla blocks (unintended behaviour).
- Fixed a missing translation key for tipped arrows.

### Changes

- Updated config default values for better feel: mounted erosion multiplier raised (1.5 → 2.0); sand erosion thresholds lowered (4/8 → 1.5/3); de-erosion timeouts rebalanced across all block types (grass stages now uniform at 5.0 days; dirt erodedDirt 13 → 8, erodedCoarseDirt 21 → 13; sand stages 1/1/2/3/5 → 3/5/8/13/13).
- Reorganized config fields order for clarity.

- **Per-block de-erosion toggle** — de-erosion can be toggled for each block type via config.
- **Vegetation whitelist in config** — vegetation erosion can be fine tuned via whitelist in config.

- Fixed More Culling compat, no more transparency of eroded sand sides.
- Fixed eroded sand stages 1–4 selection outline not matching visual geometry.
- Fixed erosion toggle settings in the config reverting to vanilla blocks (unintended behaviour).
